title: MiniHood
author: IntroductionSouth513
selftext:
Hi everyone! I made a cozy browser game where you decorate a tiny house and adopt AI "pets" that chat back. 

it's called MiniHood, a small online world that plays in the browser on phone or computer. no download.

\- decorate your own mini house piece by piece, then walk around inside it

\- adopt any of 10 AI buddies (house cat, robot butler, ghost storyteller...). a small AI model on your device lets them chat back

\- drop by other players' places and add friends

\- pixel-art 2D, or 3D if your phone can take it

how I built it: Claude Code wrote almost all of it. 250 of the 259 commits have Claude on them, around 54k lines of TypeScript and 3,273 automated tests. the furniture and characters are drawn in code too, no image generator.

my job was deciding what goes in and playing it. when the avatar editor made you scroll up and down to see your character, I asked for tabs with a live preview and it rebuilt the screen. Claude works off a kanban board and writes the tests first. nothing goes live without my ok.

open beta, free to play. guest mode is one tap. the first 50 Google sign-ins get Plus for life and 2,500 coins.

[https://minihood.sg/](https://minihood.sg/)

still fixing things, so if something breaks there's a report button in the menu.

enjoy!
